name: C12-18 Alkyl Amines
description: C12-18 Alkyl Amines (CAS 68153-95-7 ) are a chain-length blend of primary fatty amines derived from natural or synthetic feedstocks. Di-C12-18-alkyl amines represent the secondary amine fraction of the same range. Both forms function as cationic nitrogen intermediates used to build surfactants, corrosion inhibitors, and surface-active agents across multiple industrial sectors. They are essential for various chemical processes. In water treatment, these amines are formulated into corrosion inhibitors that form protective films on metal surfaces in cooling towers and pipeline systems. This helps maintain the integrity of industrial infrastructure. Textile and leather processors use them as wetting and softening agents, improving fiber penetration during dyeing and finishing operations. This ensures a high-quality finish for consumer and industrial goods. Mining operations rely on them as flotation collectors and ore-surface modifiers, selectively separating mineral fractions in beneficiation circuits. This process is vital for efficient mineral extraction and processing. In industrial cleaning and home care formulations, they serve as emulsification and dispersion actives that help lift and suspend oils, soils, and particulates from hard surfaces. They are highly effective cleaners. C12-18 Alkyl Amines are supplied as amber to yellow liquids or low-melting solids depending on chain length distribution. Technical grade is the standard commercial specification for most industrial applications. Purity and amine value are confirmed by titration per supplier certificate of analysis.
